text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 多题材场景60组 · 55 · 暖棕塔楼公共休息室.
Environment:  A round magic-academy tower common room, cream wool sofas, warm brown leather armchair, carved oak tables with closed books, small softly glowing hearth and broad Gothic window framing rolling hills. A few floating paper sheets without text, restrained magic. Pale stone walls, no portraits, statues, ghosts, coats of arms with animals or people. Warm high-key daylight dominates firelight.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic overhead CONCEPT PLAN. Depict footprint, connected zones, wall thickness, doors, windows, stairs, furniture footprints and circulation. For outdoors use a site plan of paths, terrain, bridges and water instead of domestic rooms. North is only design orientation. Compact labels; no invented metric dimensions. Flat diagram on white background.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Produce a flat CAD-style 2D concept floor/site plan for the reference location. This is a diagram, NOT an illustration or isometric rendering. Camera perpendicular 90 degrees to ground; ALL furniture/structures horizontal footprint symbols only. ABSOLUTELY NO VERTICAL SURFACES OR SCENERY OR OBJECT FRONTS. Black filled wall strips, three thin parallel window lines, door quarter-circle arcs, furniture simple top-down rectangles/circles, stairs parallel lines with UP arrow. White background, flat pale zone colors. No lighting, shadows, depth, photographic textures or fake dimensions. Clearly label zones and access; infer unseen boundaries conservatively as dashed lines. Preserve exact major structure/door/window/furniture layout. Outdoors use paths, terrain contours, tree circles and water polygons. No people/animals. Title CONCEPT PLAN. Same scene: 多题材场景60组 · 55 · 暖棕塔楼公共休息室
